applicabilityBasis.summary: mHYPER is a NAV-linked blockchain-based investment certificate issued by Midas Software GmbH. Its July 17, 2026 final terms identify the Hyperithm LLC reference portfolio and investment-performance exposure. Standard redemption uses NAV per token less fees, with USDC settlement and applicable gates or holdbacks. The documented debt-security structure supports the tracker excluded-security classification; this is not a U.S. securities ruling.

genius.licensingRegulator: Liechtenstein FMA (prospectus-approving authority under the EU Prospectus Regulation; Midas Software GmbH is not FMA-licensed)
genius.notes: GENIUS section 2(22) requires fixed monetary-value redemption and separately excludes securities. This tracker perimeter classification follows the token-specific investment-certificate/debt-security documents and is not a U.S. judicial or regulatory securities determination. FMA prospectus approval is a document review, not issuer licensing or GENIUS approval. No U.S. issuer pathway, federal regulator, state regulator or foreign-issuer registration is asserted. The token-specific issuer portfolio API returned public positions, assets, liabilities and equity with an October 7, 2026 update timestamp. ReserveDisclosurePresent records that self-reported portfolio disclosure, not an independently audited reserve report or a requirement to hold the notional underlying. RedemptionPolicyPresent is false because standard redemption follows NAV less fees and limitations rather than a fixed USD 1 monetary-value entitlement. Monthly independent reserve-attestation posture is omitted because the current methodology page could not be independently reopened.
